supports: latent physical-state reconstruction from saved modal features
scope.critical_caveat: All four state variables were present during every saved physical capture. Offline masking removes decoder features, not the corresponding physical drive.

metrics.split_rule: (x + y + I[vx>0] + I[vy>0]) mod 2 == 0 is enrolled
metrics.interpretation: This tests geometric known-state versus held-out-state rejection. The parity split is not a semantic vocabulary and cannot establish word validity.
